description: This file defines a Kotlin class named CartAdapter which extends ListAdapter to manage and display a list of cart items and headers in a RecyclerView for an online shopping app. It includes ViewHolder classes for headers and items, diff utility for efficient updates, and handles user interactions such as increment, decrement, and remove actions on cart items.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying shopping cart items and headers, supporting item diffing and user interaction for cart modifications.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns view type (header or item) for a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders depending on the row type.

inner_classes.name: HeaderVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder for header rows, binds category title.

inner_classes.name: ItemVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder for cart item rows, binds item details and handles user button clicks.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Determines if two CartRow objects represent the same item.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two CartRow objects are identical.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for the item at a specified position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the appropriate layout and creates a ViewHolder based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on the row type.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Method in ViewHolders to bind data to views, such as setting text and button actions.
